en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard depicting a Renaissance-style civic building with ornate stonework, steep slate roofs with dormer windows, and a central tower-like projection. In front of the building stands a large statue on a pedestal and a tall decorative streetlamp. The card has printed French text at the top identifying the scene as the Palais de Justice and former Cour des Comptes in Grenoble.
